Under RSJ miss, I did my BUS173.
She teaches well enough and her grading is good too
You do need to attend every class, and note down everything, and pay attention to her as she'd often drop hints as to what you can expect to see in the exams
Questions are not really that hard but you do need to study carefully so that you don't have silly mistakes, as it's very easy to lose a lot of marks making such mistakes
2 quizzes, best 1 is counted
2 midterms
1 group assignment
1 final
She may curve your grades based on class performance, but best to interact with her consistently in class. She may sound rude but she's very helpful when needed, but doesn't like bullshit though, and she does notice consistency
The assignment task will be divided equally between your teammate, and their part of the work won't affect how much you would get; like they could get a zero where as you can get full marks
This review is based on my experience doing BUS173 under her
